title: Attenuator
text: Model attenuator for RF circuit; {Attenuation (dB)} sets the level of insertion loss or attenuation, {Input impedance (Ohm)}, {Output impedance (Ohm)}, {Simulate noise} sets the simulate thermal noise and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Attenuation (dB)
params.values: Level of insertion loss or attenuation 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
